title: heygen-com/hyperframes
claim: heygen-com/hyperframes — Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
why_good: Turn HTML into rendered video, built for agents — a clean primitive for programmatic video (ads, real-estate, personalized clips).
value: Usage-based render API for agents/marketing teams generating video at scale; per-render or seat pricing.
risk: Video render is compute-heavy and crowded (Remotion, HeyGen itself); needs a real cost/quality or distribution edge.

zh.claim: heygen-com/hyperframes —— 写 HTML,渲染成视频,为 agent 而建。
zh.why_good: 把 HTML 变成渲染视频,为 agent 而建——程序化视频(广告、房产、个性化短片)的一个干净原语。
zh.value: 给规模化生成视频的 agent/营销团队做按量渲染 API:按次或按席位。
zh.risk: 视频渲染重算力且拥挤(Remotion、HeyGen 本身);要有真正的成本/质量或分发优势。
